items.title: Assignment 3 parts A and B: requirements updated
items.text: The teaching team has clarified the submission requirements for Assignment 3. Part A remains unchanged, but Part B must now include a short comparison table. The updated specification is available in the course site.
items.evidenceQuote: Part B must now include a short comparison table

items.title: Assignment 4 Part 1 submission deadline
items.text: The course assessment page lists the submission deadline for Assignment 4 Part 1 as 11:55 pm on the published date. The item is an official system record of a due time.
items.evidenceQuote: lists the submission deadline for Assignment 4 Part 1 as 11:55 pm

items.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A session registration
items.text: A voluntary Q&A session for Assignment 2 Part 3 will be held next week. Students who want to attend should register using the course form before the session reaches capacity.
items.evidenceQuote: Students who want to attend should register

items.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A: reminder
items.text: Reminder: registration for the Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A session closes tomorrow. The session is optional and will not be recorded.
items.evidenceQuote: registration for the Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A session closes tomorrow

items.title: Video submission guidelines not in the specification
items.text: A student asks for guidance about how long each slide should remain visible and whether the speaker must appear on camera. No staff answer has been posted.
items.evidenceQuote: No staff answer has been posted.

items.title: Self-reflective question quiz closing time
items.text: The course quiz page lists a closing time for the self-reflective question activity. Students who intend to complete it must submit before the closing time; the item does not state that late attempts are accepted.
items.evidenceQuote: Students who intend to complete it must submit before the closing time

items.title: New sign-in notification
items.text: A new browser sign-in was detected for the university account. The notice includes a device and approximate location that the account owner should verify. If it was not the owner, the account security steps should be followed immediately.
items.evidenceQuote: If it was not the owner, the account security steps should be followed immediately.

items.title: Can a member initialisation list set a constant?
items.text: A student asks whether a constructor member initialisation list can set an instance constant. A staff reply confirms the pattern and points to a language reference example.
items.evidenceQuote: A staff reply confirms the pattern

items.title: Tuition payment deadline changed
items.text: The student finance office has moved the payment deadline for the next teaching period. Students with an outstanding balance must review the new date and contact finance if they cannot pay on time.
items.evidenceQuote: Students with an outstanding balance must review the new date

items.title: Week 10 task: PKI explanation
items.text: A student shares a draft explanation of public-key infrastructure and certificate authorities as part of a weekly learning task. The post has no staff correction or deadline change.
items.evidenceQuote: A student shares a draft explanation of public-key infrastructure

items.title: Clayton seminar recording available
items.text: The teaching team has uploaded a recording of the recent seminar and a copy of the slides. The material is supplementary and no completion action is requested.
items.evidenceQuote: The material is supplementary

items.title: SETU survey reminder and gift-card promotion
items.text: Students are invited to complete the end-of-unit survey for a chance to enter a gift-card draw. The survey is not described as a course requirement.
items.evidenceQuote: chance to enter a gift-card draw

items.title: Week 9 future internet prediction
items.text: A student posts a speculative response about how internet infrastructure may change in the future. The post is part of a learning task and has no staff feedback.
items.evidenceQuote: The post is part of a learning task

items.title: Final test: last sitting and room details
items.text: A staff announcement states that the final test has one remaining sitting, gives the date and room, and reminds students that passing the test is required to pass the unit.
items.evidenceQuote: passing the test is required to pass the unit

items.title: Additional Q&A session for Assignment 2 Part 3
items.text: An additional Q&A session has been opened for Assignment 2 Part 3 after the first session filled. Registration is optional and closes at the end of the day.
items.evidenceQuote: Registration is optional

items.title: Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A: final registration notice
items.text: This is the final notice for the optional Assignment 2 Part 3 Q&A. Use the registration form if you need to attend; no registration is needed to submit the assignment.
items.evidenceQuote: Use the registration form if you need to attend

items.title: Peer Student Supporter recruitment
items.text: The student wellbeing office is recruiting volunteers for a peer-support program. Applications are open to interested students and are unrelated to course assessment.
items.evidenceQuote: unrelated to course assessment

items.title: Campus wellbeing day trip promotion
items.text: A student association is advertising an optional wellbeing day trip during the exam period. Tickets are limited and the message contains no academic requirement.
items.evidenceQuote: optional wellbeing day trip

items.title: Scheduled library systems outage
items.text: Library search and several borrowing services will be unavailable during a scheduled maintenance window this weekend. Students should plan research access around the outage.
items.evidenceQuote: Students should plan research access around the outage.

items.title: New sign-in notification: duplicate alert
items.text: A second notification reports the same unfamiliar browser sign-in for the university account. It points to the same security review instructions.
items.evidenceQuote: same security review instructions

items.title: Extension application received
items.text: The university has received an extension request and will review the supporting information. This message confirms receipt only; it does not approve or reject the request.
items.evidenceQuote: This message confirms receipt only; it does not approve or reject the request.

items.title: Extension application received: duplicate
items.text: A duplicate confirmation says the extension request is under review. No outcome or new deadline is stated.
items.evidenceQuote: A duplicate confirmation says the extension request is under review.

items.title: Student Barometer survey reminder
items.text: The university is asking students to complete a voluntary Student Barometer survey before it closes. The message asks for feedback but does not state that completion affects enrolment or grades.
items.evidenceQuote: voluntary Student Barometer survey

items.title: Short extension approved for Assignment 4 Part 3
items.text: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 3. The original due time and the revised due time are listed in the notice. Students should check the assessment page before submitting.
items.evidenceQuote: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 3.

items.title: Short extension approved for Assignment 4 Part 4
items.text: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 4. The revised deadline differs from Part 3, so the student should verify which part the approval covers.
items.evidenceQuote: A short extension has been approved for Assignment 4 Part 4

items.title: Retail account one-time password

items.evidenceQuote: unrelated to study

items.title: Student election: final voting reminder
items.text: Students are reminded that voting in an optional student representative election closes today. The message contains candidate information and no academic consequence.
items.evidenceQuote: no academic consequence

items.title: Classroom change for the final test
items.text: The final test will be held in a different room than the one shown in the earlier timetable. Students must use the new room listed in the announcement.
items.evidenceQuote: Students must use the new room listed in the announcement.

items.title: Exam timetable room update
items.text: The university exam timetable now lists the room and check-in instructions for the upcoming exam period. The update affects attendance logistics but does not change the exam date.
items.evidenceQuote: now lists the room and check-in instructions

items.title: Counselling appointment confirmation
items.text: A counselling service confirms an appointment time and asks the student to reply if the time no longer works. The appointment is private and unrelated to course requirements.
items.evidenceQuote: asks the student to reply if the time no longer works

items.title: Course announcement: optional practice questions
items.text: The teaching team has posted a set of optional practice questions for the next topic. The questions are for revision and are not collected or graded.
items.evidenceQuote: optional practice questions

items.title: Final test: last sitting and room details
items.text: The final test has one remaining sitting. The message gives the date and room and reminds students that passing the test is required to pass the unit.
items.evidenceQuote: passing the test is required to pass the unit

items.title: Where should the consolidated code be uploaded?
items.text: A student asks whether the consolidated source code should be placed in the PDF, the ZIP archive, or both because the submission form shows only two upload slots. A staff reply says to include it in the ZIP and use the PDF for the report.
items.evidenceQuote: include it in the ZIP and use the PDF for the report

items.title: Week 12 task: password storage notes
items.text: A student posts draft notes explaining salted password hashing and slow password-hashing functions. No question about assessment requirements is asked and no staff reply is present.
items.evidenceQuote: draft notes explaining salted password hashing

items.title: Attempt at an exam proof
items.text: A student posts an attempted proof for a past exam question. Other students can use it for revision, but the post is not an official solution and no staff answer is attached.
items.evidenceQuote: attempted proof for a past exam question

items.title: Career task: security analyst role notes
items.text: A student shares notes about a security analyst job description while completing a career-related learning task. The post does not change the task requirements or request a staff decision.
items.evidenceQuote: shares notes about a security analyst job description

items.title: Question about a logic equivalence proof
items.text: A student asks whether a proposed transformation proves a logic equivalence. No staff or tutor response has been posted yet, so the correctness of the approach is unresolved.
items.evidenceQuote: No staff or tutor response has been posted yet

items.title: Is a six-minute presentation acceptable?
items.text: A student asks whether a presentation shorter than the stated maximum is acceptable. A staff response says the maximum is not a minimum and reminds students to cover all required points.
items.evidenceQuote: the maximum is not a minimum

items.title: Assignment 4 Part 2 slide structure
items.text: A student asks whether the required points for Assignment 4 Part 2 can be paraphrased on slides and whether evidence must be shown for every point. No official answer is visible yet.
items.evidenceQuote: A student asks whether the required points for Assignment 4 Part 2 can be paraphrased on slides

items.title: Question about secure password storage
items.text: A student asks whether a password manager or salted hashing should be discussed in the weekly answer. The thread contains peer suggestions but no staff conclusion.
items.evidenceQuote: The thread contains peer suggestions but no staff conclusion.

items.title: Can I pass after failing the unit hurdle?
items.text: A student asks whether a high exam result can compensate for failing the in-semester hurdle. A staff reply explains that the hurdle is a separate pass condition.
items.evidenceQuote: the hurdle is a separate pass condition

items.title: Week 12 wrap-up and seminar recording
items.text: A staff announcement links a final seminar recording and invites general feedback about the unit. It does not introduce a new assessment requirement or deadline.
items.evidenceQuote: It does not introduce a new assessment requirement or deadline.

items.title: Can an AI assistant be cited as a reference?
items.text: A student asks whether an AI assistant can be included as a reference for Assignment 4 Part 2. A staff reply says the answer depends on the assessment's source rules and points to the referencing section.
items.evidenceQuote: the answer depends on the assessment's source rules

items.title: Student explanation of password hashing
items.text: A student posts a second explanation of salted password hashing for a weekly task. It is similar to another student discussion but is not an official answer.
items.evidenceQuote: A student posts a second explanation of salted password hashing

items.title: Can the presentation video exceed eight minutes?
items.text: A student says the presentation is over the eight-minute maximum because of pauses. A staff reply says the submission must be edited to meet the maximum duration.
items.evidenceQuote: the submission must be edited to meet the maximum duration

items.title: Updated link for today's Q&A session

items.evidenceQuote: gives a replacement link for a Q&A session happening later today
